title: Image
description: Image data used to create a texture. Derived from the glTF 2.0 image schema, except that glTF's integer ids are replaced by the id of the Mosaic node carrying the referenced component, so a reference survives any change to component ordering.

uri.description: The URI of the image, or a data: URI holding it inline. Mutually exclusive with bufferView.

mimeType.description: The image's media type. Required when bufferView is used.

bufferView.description: The id of the Mosaic node carrying the bufferView component holding the image bytes.
